sentences.text:
Maksud Alam @ Alam vs Unknown on 12 September, 2024
 12.09.2024
 Ct. No. 06
 Sl No. 109
 S.De
 C.R.M. (Db) 3010 of 2024
In Re: - An application for bail under Section 439 of the   Criminal Procedure corresponding to Section 483 of the Bha  Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023
Case No. 348 of 2023 dated 02.03.2023 under Sections  498A/307/109/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

And  In the matter of: Maksud Alam @ Alam.
 Mr. Arup Kumar Bhowmick ...for th  Mr. Subhamoy Bhattacharyya,
 Mr. Bikram Mitra, ....for the State.

1.
Petitioner submits the vital witness, that is, the injured wife stated she suffered accidental burn injuries.
2. In view of the aforesaid fact, we are of the opinion petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

3. Accordingly, we direct the petitioner viz. Maksud Alam @ Alam shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local,
to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Malda subject to the condition that the petitioner shall appear before the trial court on each and every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses and/or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
4. In the event petitioner fails to appear before the Trial Court without any justifiable cause, the Trial Court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail without any further reference to this Court.
5. The application for bail is, thus, allowed and disposed of.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi,
J.) Signed By :
SANDIP DE High Court of Calcutta 13 th of September 2024 07:36:35 PM Maksud Alam @ Alam vs Unknown on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14885876/
